abstract: Maintains high-voltage converter specifications, transmission capacities, and switchgear leak mitigation records
system_message:
You are the Electrical systems lead (ELE), responsible for maintaining high-voltage converter specifications, transmission capacities, switchgear leak mitigation records, and harmonic filter compliance assessments across offshore platform layout options.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains high-voltage converter specifications, transmission capacities, and switchgear leak mitigation records（GRID）
information_points.content:
ELE-GRID-UCV：For the Monopod Jack-up Truss Layout, gas-insulated switchgear leak mitigation is verified based on converter hall SF6 containment checks, and its rated converter transmission capacity is 1500 MW evaluated on a capacity accounting basis gross before deducting auxiliary platform power loads.
ELE-GRID-O8I：For the Monopod Jack-up Truss Layout, gas-insulated switchgear leak mitigation is verified based on converter hall SF6 containment checks, and its rated converter transmission capacity is 900 MW evaluated on a capacity accounting basis net of auxiliary platform power loads.
ELE-GRID-O8L：For the Deep-Draft Floating Spar Layout, gas-insulated switchgear leak mitigation is not verified based on converter hall SF6 containment checks, and its rated converter transmission capacity is 1200 MW evaluated on a capacity accounting basis net of auxiliary platform power loads.
ELE-GRID-ADV：For the Modular Four-Legged Jacket Layout, gas-insulated switchgear leak mitigation is verified based on converter hall SF6 containment checks, and its rated converter transmission capacity is 900 MW evaluated on a capacity accounting basis net of auxiliary platform power loads.

information_points.title: Harmonic filter compliance（HARM）
information_points.content:
ELE-HARM-MHA：For the Deep-Draft Floating Spar Layout, the total harmonic voltage distortion factor at the converter busbar under nominal full transmission load is 2%.
ELE-HARM-ZJE：For the Monopod Jack-up Truss Layout, the total harmonic voltage distortion factor at the converter busbar under nominal full transmission load is 5%.
ELE-HARM-RYA：For the Modular Four-Legged Jacket Layout, the total harmonic voltage distortion factor at the converter busbar under nominal full transmission load is 3%.
